koh-samui.label: Koh Samui + the Gulf island triangle

_fare_record.source: Koh Samui (Bangrak/Maenam) -> Koh Phangan (Thong Sala)
_fare_record.notes: Lomprayah scheduled high-speed seat THB 350 = ~$10 as the contested floor; premium charter ceiling far higher (see premium_ceiling_note).

_demand_record.source: Koh Samui (Bangrak/Maenam) -> Koh Phangan (Thong Sala)
_demand_record.detail: 12 * 20000 * 0.98 * 0.55 = ~129,360 FMP-driven Samui<->Phangan pax/yr (one-way). Add ~year-round baseline ferry traffic (separate). Premium-eligible slice = 129,360 * 0.15 = ~19,400 premium one-way trips/yr from the FMP pool alone.

_fare_record.anchor_type: fast_catamaran_per_seat_above_car_ferry (Lomprayah high-speed cat ~45 min Samui<->Donsak vs 1.5-2h car ferries)
_fare_record.notes: Anchor THB 500/pp one-way = USD 15.2: Lomprayah runs a ~45-min high-speed catamaran Samui<->Donsak (Tripadvisor review; lomprayah.com Surat Thani route via Donsak); Surat Thani-Samui combo (ferry+coach) averages ~USD 18 / THB 600-700 (Omio; travelfish '700 baht'), ferry-only leg de-bundled to ~THB 500. Fare ladder (THB/pp): Raja car ferry 160 (busonlineticket/siamtickets); Seatran car ferry 180-225 (siamtickets/ferrysamui); Lomprayah fast-cat ~500 <- premium per-seat anchor; +coach combos 600-700. R5-EXT validity check PASSED: a real premium per-seat tier (fast cat) exists above the standard car ferry - no cascade. FX 32.85.

_demand_record.source: Total Samui<->Donsak crossing (all operators/piers). Raja Ferry Port (SET: RP) disclosed ~1.2M passengers carried in 2017 (+20% YoY) across its Donsak-Samui(Lipa Noi)/Donsak-Phangan network, with a 1.5M target (Samui Times / Koh Samui News quoting RP business plan; RP IPO-era disclosure ~600k/yr 2014, Nation Thailand). Seatran runs 6 vessels ~hourly 05:00-19:00 Nathon<->Donsak (Tripadvisor/operator). Mode balance: Samui drew ~3.54M tourists 2023 (Forbes/C9) vs ~1.4M airport arrivals (Samui Airport 2.8M total pax 2024, BAREIT one-report 56-1) - the majority of non-air arrivals cross at Donsak.
_demand_record.method: Sum of operator slices: Raja ~0.85M (1.2M 2017 x ~70% Samui-route share) + Seatran ~1.2M (R4 freq x capacity, see mint record) = ~2.05M -> 2.0M one-way/yr. Cross-check vs mode balance (~2M+ sea arrivals+departures via Donsak for 3.5M visitors) holds. Components are 2017-vintage + modeled, hence med-low.

_fare_record.anchor_type: same crossing as rn-347c44e1d360 (Raja vehicle-ferry pier pair) - inherits the fast-cat premium per-seat anchor
_fare_record.notes: Raja's own product is the THB 160 single-class vehicle ferry (budget tier); premium per-seat tier on the crossing is the ~THB 500 fast-cat point (see rn-347c44e1d360). FX 32.85.

_demand_record.source: SUBSET of rn-347c44e1d360 (do not sum). Raja Ferry Port (SET-listed, RP) company disclosure: ~1.2M passengers + ~600k vehicles carried in 2017 (+20% over 2016) across Donsak-Lipa Noi (Samui) and Donsak-Phangan routes; ~14 ferries, up to 50 trips/day (RP business plan via Koh Samui News/Samui Times; CreditRiskMonitor profile). RP FY2024 (2567) one-report exists but is a scanned PDF; per-route pax not machine-readable.
_demand_record.method: 1.2M RP network pax (2017) x ~70% Samui-route share = ~850k one-way/yr on Lipa Noi<->Donsak. Company-disclosed base (T2) but 2017-vintage + modeled route split -> med-low. Post-Covid recovery assumed roughly back to 2017 levels given Samui 2024 visitation above pre-Covid.

_fare_record.anchor_type: same crossing as rn-347c44e1d360 (Seatran pier pair) - inherits the fast-cat premium per-seat anchor
_fare_record.notes: Seatran's own product is the THB 180-225 single-class car ferry (budget/standard tier); the crossing's premium per-seat tier is the ~THB 500 fast-cat point (see rn-347c44e1d360). FX 32.85.

_demand_record.source: SUBSET of rn-347c44e1d360 (do not sum). Seatran Ferry: 6 vessels, ~hourly departures 05:00-19:00 each way, 13-16 kt, ~1.5h crossing, ~450-pax + ~70-car capacity per vessel (Tripadvisor operator page; thailandboattickets.com; C9 Hotelworks cited in city brief). No published Seatran annual ridership found.
_demand_record.method: R4 frequency x capacity: ~14 sailings/day/direction x 2 directions x ~450 pax x ~33% pax load x 365 = ~1.2M one-way/yr. Tagged T5/modeled per R4; low-med.

_fare_record.anchor_type: same crossing as rn-db5e83248f9d - inherits the Santhiya resort-speedboat per-seat anchor
_fare_record.notes: Pier-exact Lomprayah leg (Pralarn->Thong Sala, 20 min, THB 300 standard fast-cat per ferryadvice.com) is the STANDARD tier; the crossing's premium per-seat tier (resort scheduled speedboat THB 1,150 = USD 35.0) is the R1 anchor. FX 32.85.

_demand_record.source: SUBSET of rn-db5e83248f9d (do not sum). Lomprayah operates the Pralarn (Mae Nam) terminal with ~4-6 daily fast-cat departures/direction to Thong Sala (lomprayah.com 2026 timetable; ferryadvice.com: Pralarn->Thong Sala 20 min, THB 300); Lomprayah is the highest-frequency operator on the crossing.
_demand_record.method: R4-style operator-share slice: Lomprayah Pralarn-pier share modeled at ~45% of the ~1.0M crossing pool = ~450k one-way/yr. Capacity sanity: ~5 sailings/day/direction x ~340-seat catamarans x 2 directions x 365 = ~1.24M seats/yr -> 450k = ~36% load, plausible.

_fare_record.anchor_type: premium_fast_catamaran_per_seat (Lomprayah/Seatran Discovery high-speed cat is the top scheduled per-seat product on this 35 nm open-water leg)
_fare_record.notes: Anchor THB 800/pp one-way = USD 24.4 (top of the published THB 700-850 fast-cat band: ticket2attraction Lomprayah ex-Pralarn from THB 700; ferryadvice 700; rome2rio THB 650-1,300; city-brief/siamtickets band 700-850). Fare ladder (THB/pp): budget Songserm/night boat ~500-600; fast-cat 700-850 <- premium scheduled tier, anchor 800; no scheduled per-seat speedboat above it (private charter only, e.g. Boonsiri Chumphon-Tao catamaran charter from THB 110,000/way - excluded as whole-boat overclaim). R13-type note: the fast cat IS the premium product on this crossing. FX 32.85.

_demand_record.source: Koh Tao: 666,778 visitors in 2024 (above pre-Covid; record), 327,000 Jan-May 2025, full-year 2025 forecast >700,000 - Koh Tao Tourism Association / TAT figures via Thairath & Daily News (T2 base). Koh Tao is boat-only (no airport, R3-EXCEPTION: arrivals = crossing ridership). Access splits between the Chumphon side (Bangkok route) and the Samui/Phangan side.
_demand_record.method: 666,778 visitors x 2 = ~1.33M one-way island boat legs/yr across all routes. Samui-side direct share (Samui<->Tao without the Phangan leg) modeled at ~30% = ~400k one-way/yr. The visitor count is T2; the route-split is modeled (T5), hence med-low. Phangan<->Tao (ics-3cf5eda189) holds a comparable separate slice - not pooled here.

_fare_record.notes: Anchor USD 79.0/pp one-way-equivalent: licensed Ang Thong speedboat day tours sell at THB 2,200 (angthongmarinepark.com, incl lunch/snorkel/kayak, 4.7/5 x 4,400 guests) up to THB 3,900 premium small-group (city brief / GetYourGuide-tier operators 2025); premium point ~THB 2,900 minus THB 300 DNP park fee (thailandee.com: foreigner entrance THB 300) = ~THB 2,600 = USD 79 (R3-PIER fee-netting: transport+experience portion only). Charter rung: Samui Boat Charter private half-day from USD 109.88/adult (Tripadvisor). Fare ladder (THB/pp): big-boat tour ~1,400-1,800; standard speedboat tour 2,200; PREMIUM small-group speedboat 2,900-3,900 <- anchor 2,900 gross / 2,600 net; private charter >= USD 110/pp. Note: day-tour RT+excursion pricing, not a clean point-to-point one-way transfer - treated as the per-seat premium willingness-to-pay on this corridor. FX 32.85.

_demand_record.source: Mu Ko Ang Thong National Marine Park: ~160,000 park visitors/yr, ~85% foreign, >THB 40M annual fee revenue (Thai PBS citing park authority, ~2024; DNP visitor-stats system catalog.dnp.go.th is the underlying register - R3-GOLD park-authority class). Park is boat-only and closed annually 1 Nov-15 Dec. Licensed speedboat day tours depart Samui (and Phangan) daily in season.
_demand_record.method: 160k park visitors x 2 = ~320k one-way park boat legs/yr -> 300k (rounding + Phangan-departure share trimmed). R3-PIER FLAG: the modeled origin is the Four Seasons (Laem Yai) jetty, but today's tour boats depart Nathon/Maenam/Bangrak - this pool is the PARK-ACCESS pool servable from Samui's NW coast, not current Four Seasons-origin ridership. Down-weighted to med-low accordingly.

corridors._captive_note: Four Seasons Koh Samui = 60 pool villas. Ceiling = ceil(60/25)=3 vessels.

koh-samui._fleet_basis_note: G51 locked ruling: market fleet = sum of raw per-corridor vessel fractions (10% capture), ceil ONCE at market level. No per-corridor math.floor zeroing of thin-but-real legs. Subset (_subset_of) slices excluded.

corridors.to: Phang Nga Bay / James Bond Island

_fare_record.source: Phuket->Phang Nga Bay/James Bond Island speedboat day-tour ladder (THB/USD 36): budget longtail ~1,400 THB ($39, phukettoursdirect); standard shared speedboat ~2,500 THB ($69); PREMIUM shared speedboat ~2,600-3,700 THB ($72-103, phiphitours/mythailandtours '$55 low-season' to ~3,700 quoted); private charter speedboat ~29,000-40,900 THB/boat/day (yacht-rental-phuket, phuketdreamcompany) = whole-boat, excluded as overclaim. Premium per-seat anchored ~2,600 THB net of 400 THB park fee = $72.
_fare_record.method: observed-premium-tier (per-seat premium speedboat, net of national-park fee; tour bundles meal+guide so transport portion conservative)

_demand_record.source: Ao Phang Nga National Park visitors FY2567 (Oct-2023..Sep-2024) = 530,204 (DNP top-10 ranking, #7 by visitors; reported by Prachachat, https://www.prachachat.net/hilight-prachachat/news-1796245, Apr-2025). Park is reachable ONLY by tour boat/longtail/speedboat (no road/air to Khao Phing Kan/Ko Tapu) -> R3-EXCEPTION holds: park arrivals = crossing ridership. DNP also runs e-ticketing at this park (one of 6 pilot parks). Pre-covid FY2019 was ~1M+ (payload note), so FY2024 is the conservative post-covid actual.
_demand_record.method: 530,204 park visitors x2 = 1,060,408 one-way boat trips (T2, turnstile/fee-paying). R3-PIER haircut: day-tours depart BOTH Phuket NE marinas (Ao Po Grand, Royal Phuket Marina, Boat Lagoon, Yacht Haven) AND Phang Nga mainland piers (Surakul/Kura, Khao Lak); Phuket-origin share modeled 0.55 -> 583,224 ~= 580,000. Per existing rule, THB 300 NP fee must be netted out of tour fares on the FARE side (not demand). Tour-boat-only corridor (no scheduled ferry) - demand is day-trip pool, not point-to-point ridership.

_fare_record.source: Phuket->Krabi (Ao Nang) speedboat premium tier ~comparable to Phi Phi route ($44). Krabi-specific demand re-source pending.

_demand_record.source: Phi Phi demand moved to new Phuket->Phi Phi corridor per Jaideep 2026-06-09. Krabi (Ao Nang) demand to be sourced separately. Until then: estimated via country cascade.

_fare_record.source: Phuket (Rassada Pier) -> Koh Phi Phi (Tonsai)
_fare_record.notes: THB 600 standard ferry = ~$17 contested floor; speedboat THB 700-1,200 and charter ceiling far higher.

_demand_record.source: Phuket (Rassada Pier) -> Koh Phi Phi (Tonsai)
_demand_record.detail: 97 sailings/wk * 52 wk * 590 cap * 0.55 LF = ~1.64M corridor seats/yr (gross, both directions implied in schedule). One-way pax pool ~ 818k/yr. Premium-eligible = 818k * 0.12 = ~98,200 premium one-way trips/yr.

_fare_record.source: Phuket->Similan/Surin premium shared speedboat day-tour (THB/USD 36): premium catamaran-speedboat tours ~2,500-2,600 THB incl 500 THB park fee+meals from Khao Lak (phiphitours 2,590 THB=$72); Phuket-origin runs higher ~2,900-3,500 THB ($80-97) for the longer 55nm leg. Private charter Phuket->Similan 50,000-80,000 THB/boat/day (forbesandpartners) = whole-boat, excluded. Premium per-seat anchored ~2,900 THB ($80) net for the longer Phuket origin.
_fare_record.method: observed-premium-tier per-seat; longer-leg Phuket origin priced above Khao Lak baseline; park fee included

_demand_record.source: Mu Ko Similan NP official visitor statistics (DNP/park clarification, May-2025, via MGR Online https://mgronline.com/uptodate/detail/9680000041761): FY2561(2018)=912,566; FY2562(2019)=676,793; FY2566(2023)=352,701; FY2567(2024)=578,535; FY2568=503,142 as of 30-Apr-2025. Daily cap 3,850 visitors/day (DNP, http://news.dnp.go.th/news/7966). Season: park CLOSED ~May 16 - Oct 14; open season ~212 days/yr (reopened 15-Oct each year, prd.go.th).
_demand_record.method: FY2024 actual 578,535 visitors x2 = 1,157,070 one-way boat trips - BUT R3-PIER applies HARD: virtually all Similan boats depart Thap Lamu pier (Phang Nga, ~60km N of Phuket), customers based in Phuket/Khao Lak; there is NO Phuket-origin sea service today. Phuket-customer-origin share ~0.5 -> ~578,000 ~= 580,000 re-routable one-way trips; confidence LOW for the named Phuket origin. season_days=212: demand concentrates to ~2,730 visitors/day avg (71% of the 3,850/day cap; cap x season = 816,200 ceiling, R4-grade cross-check). Surin Is. (separate NP, boats from Kuraburi, same seasonal closure) NOT added - would be additive but even further from Phuket.

_fare_record.source: Phuket (Rassada Pier)->Langkawi (Telaga Harbour) operated daily by Satun Pakbara Speed Boat Club, speedboat+ferry combo via Koh Lipe (immigration stop), ~8.5h, 1 trip/day. Fare THB 4,100 = ~$115 one-way (ferrysamui.com, directferries, ferryscanner); Omio cross-check $89-117 (Tigerline). Single-class long-haul cross-border - the operating fare IS the premium per-seat (no budget tier on this combo).
_fare_record.method: observed live booking fare; single-class combo route = premium per-seat by default (R5-EXT inverse: this is a real premium long-haul transfer, not a commuter flat fare)

_demand_record.source: Daily combo speedboat/ferry operates (Satun Pakbara) but NO published ridership. Niche pool: visa-runners + Koh Lipe through-traffic; most Phuket<->Langkawi travelers FLY (AirAsia direct). Freq x capacity floor: 1 boat/day x ~40 seats x ~0.5 load x ~210 season-days ~ 4k/yr - too thin/speculative to anchor.
_demand_record.method: NULL beats a guess (R2). Route operates (not greenfield/lapsed) but unpublished + structurally thin cross-border niche -> flag to cascade.

_demand_record.unit: pax/yr (day-experience rides ex-Chalong; one ticket = one ride/loop, no doubling)
_demand_record.gross_pool_basis: T2 GOVERNMENT TURNSTILE-GRADE ANCHOR: Marine Department regional office (Phuket branch) counts reported by Prachachat, 13-Apr-2024 (Songkran holiday): 119 tour-boat departures from Chalong Pier carrying >2,500 tourists in one day, destinations 'especially Ko He (Coral) and Ko Racha', activities cruising/snorkelling/fishing/sunset; plus 36 marina departures; province-wide same day 379 departures / 11,637 pax (+25% YoY). Annualization (T3 layer): holiday-peak day scaled to average day at 0.40-0.60x (Andaman May-Oct monsoon + shoulder seasons) = 1,000-1,500 pax/day = 365k-550k gross; ~10% strip for Racha resort-transfer legs (The Racha/Rayaburi overnight guests on tour boats) and any Chalong-departing Phi Phi-bound boats (overlap guard vs ics-8c6c7ae8ee) -> floor 300k / base 400k / ceiling 550k (ceiling holds the 0.60x scaling with no strip).

_demand_record.haircut_rationale: GROUNDED: real, government-counted on-water ridership (LB-98 species 3) - the Marine Dept count is of passengers boarding boats, not waterfront foot traffic. The only inferred layer is peak-to-average seasonality (T3, 0.40-0.60x band drives floor/ceiling) plus a 10% strip for resort-transfer/other-pool legs. Fleet cross-check consistent: 119 documented departures on a peak day from a 1-km pier; year-round daily schedules from HYPE (80-seat cat) + 104-pax and 38-pax cats + dozens of 20-30-seat speedboats. Navier 10% capture applied downstream by the engine, competing as the premium small-group electric tier under the THB 1,250-3,900 ladder.
_demand_record.lb91_test: PASS by construction: every counted pax was boarding a boat (Marine Dept pier count). Chalong waterfront restaurant/marina foot traffic and land-arriving beach visitors are NOT counted (R3-LAND). Ko He/Racha are boat-only islands - no land-arrival conflation possible.
_demand_record.dedupe: ONE merged pool for all parallel Chalong-origin per-seat operators per LB-86. Zero overlap with ics-b737c5ae68 (Phang Nga, NE-marina departures - 0.55 Phuket-origin share there was built on NE marinas, not Chalong), ics-8c6c7ae8ee (Phi Phi, Rassada/NE piers; any Chalong Phi Phi departures stripped in the 10% haircut), ics-2ca88ff772 (Similan, Thap Lamu mainland pier). Racha overnight-resort transfer legs stripped in haircut. The premium Phang Nga subset row below shares NO pax with this pool (different piers, different waterway).

Operators sailing the NE-Phuket -> Phang Nga premium small-group product: (1) Simba Sea Trips - 'every tour capped at 18 adults' (T2 TripAdvisor operator listing), daily 'Phang Nga Bay and Beyond' departure ex-Boat Lagoon, operating since 2005 (T2 GetYourGuide supplier page); (2) Phuket Sail Tours - big boat Ngamkom 'licensed for 45 passengers but we won't take more than 20 adults' (T2 TripAdvisor product page quoting operator), James Bond day tour + separate sunset tour ex-Ao Por Public Pier (T1 operator site) = up to 2 departures/day; (3) John Gray's Sea Canoe - Hong by Starlight daily ex-Ao Po Pier (T2 Agoda itinerary), 'Maximum 40 Persons per boat' (T3 listing copy - excluded from floor build, Quicksilver precedent). Capacities where published: CP Princess fleet 150-450 pax/hull (T2 BKK Post), Viva Alangka 700 / Royal Princess 600 / Alangka 400 (T2 guide), Chaophraya Cruise 290 (T1 operator site chaophrayacruise.com). Build: floor 20 hulls x 1 sailing/night x 250 avg cap x 40% load = 2,000/night = 730k/yr; base 25 hulls x 1 x 300 x 50% = 3,750/night = 1.37M, haircut to 1.2M; ceiling 25 hulls x 1.4 sailings (sunset+dinner doubles) x 325 x 60% = 6,800/night = 2.5M, capped at 2.0M. Cross-check: CP Princess alone runs 5-8 trips/day (T2 BKK Post) ~ 350k pax/yr at mid assumptions and is the largest operator -> market 3-4x Princess = 1.1-1.4M, consistent with base.
